meta.title: Day {day} of {days}: The Break Room Goes Dark
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day {day} of {days}: the Break Room and every vendor lose service, the terminal key is gone, and the Green Room is the only honest saferoom. Three routes, four encounters, key availability, early-descent handling, rest options with the rest-without-saferoom slot, last-chance hooks and a stall fallback. CR, budget, credit and loot figures are cited from rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json by field path (GM-adaptable guideline). Collapse notices use Lore's draft wording; the final collapse is fixed and a missed collapse is death on every floor, with no Reprieve.

clock.zone_groups: Confirmed (decision 026, tagged inspired): outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close Day 2; mid zones (Z5, Z7 and Z8) close Day 3; on Day 4 the Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; on Day 5 only the corridor (Z10, Z11 and Z S) remains. final_collapse.status: Syndicate default, decision 026; Caleb may veto
final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day {days} (hour {floor_hours} of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.tag: canon-aligned (canon: a missed collapse ends the run)
collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death and revival follow Core Book Ch1, Death and Revival: death is permanent, Costly Revives are the default (rare and expensive), and a Replacement Crawler is the usual outcome. Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.
collapse_miss.stasis_counts: Early-descent stasis (canon M-277) counts as reaching a stairwell.
collapse_miss.detour_tax_scope: The Detour Tax now covers only a missed Stairwell key, never a missed collapse.

saferoom_rule.text: The Break Room (Z6) is a saferoom through Day 3 and stops being one when it loses service on Day 4 (Syndicate ruling, decision 026). From then on the Z9 Green Room is the only saferoom, open to the end of the floor (tagged inspired).

clock.achievement_caps: Floor caps still apply: the soft cap is 2 to 3 achievement boxes per Crawler per floor (Caleb's ruling), and Floors 1 and 2 keep the Silver ceiling. Story Boxes are separate: at most one per floor on Floors 1 and 2, outside the box caps and the budget. Rewards are tailored by the GM and snark-only is allowed; the proposed achievements are a seed list at GM discretion.

rest_fee_note.text: GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

day.stall_fallback: If the party stalls, the Lights-Out hour arrives, the countdown ticks, and the System offers a Long Rest at the Green Room. A party with no key yet can still pay the toll, use tools or force the door, or take the boss route. Do not steer anyone toward early descent. A Crawler who is not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, with no Reprieve (decision 026); keep the warning in view.

system_intro.text: SERVICE OUTAGE. Terminal offline. Vendors offline. Break Room rest unsupported.

midpoint_twist.text: The fridge light clicks off. In the dark, a lone sandwich sits with a name taped to it. Nobody dares.

win.text: Last meal eaten, last crumb shared, last credit spent. Go on. The building isn't going to hold your hand.

gm_color.text: The coffee has finally won. We apologize for nothing.

loot_hooks.note: Fridge sandwich: last chance to share it.

encounters.if_they_do_something_dumb: If someone tries to use the dead terminal, the screen shows OUT OF ORDER and a snarky line. If they try to rest here as if it were still a saferoom, it is a field rest: only a Short Rest, with the price cited at {{b70:floors.1.prices.rest_without_saferoom}} and no Long Rest. Never a wipe. GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

quick_run.setup: The Break Room is dark and the door sign reads OUT OF ORDER, BOTH OF US.

quick_run.on_failure: A Crawler tries to rest here and finds it is no longer a saferoom.
quick_run.cut_short: Read the sign, say it is no longer a saferoom, and move on.

changes.choice: Try to rest in the dead Break Room

changes.choice: Take the last look at the corkboard and terminal

lines.text: The lights go out in sections, one hall at a time, until only your own lantern is left. The dark makes a sound, a slow settling, like a building thinking.
You find a dead-end alcove and sit with your backs to the wall. Every few minutes the far end of the hall clicks, ticks, and goes quiet again.
Someone has left a half-eaten ration and a note on the floor: "Slept here. Do not recommend." No signature.
Rest is possible, but it is not comfortable. Whoever takes watch hears an announcement chime from three zones away, muffled, like a door closing on a party you were not invited to.

zone_color.gm_note: GM note (from Lore's hook): a rest here can be interrupted by a dumb, loud, wrong-footed mob, which keeps the cost real without being cruel.

quick_run.setup: Dark halls and red light; the party is far from the Green Room and tired.
quick_run.decision: Pay for a quiet field rest (a Short Rest only), or push back to the Green Room?

quick_run.on_failure: Ceiling Ticks interrupt the rest and spoil it.
quick_run.cut_short: Skip the camp description and roll once for the interruption.

changes.choice: Make noise or light a fire

gm_color.text: The usher's flashlight finds you before you find the door. 'Please silence your screams,' says a polite voice from the dark. They don't mean the phones.

quick_run.on_failure: The beams catch the party and the Dean is warned.
